blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: evaluation — Judgement supported by evidence and limitations.
risk-driven — Development priorities guided by significant uncertainties.
stakeholder — Person or organisation affected by a project.

blocks.title: Avoid a universal answer
blocks.text: Method suitability depends on risk, requirements, regulation, user access and timescale.

blocks.title: Support with scenario evidence
blocks.text: A high-risk system may justify Spiral's explicit risk analysis despite extra overhead.

blocks.title: Include a drawback
blocks.text: Evaluate cost, documentation, flexibility and technical quality rather than merely naming a method.

blocks.title: Worked example · Predict the method
blocks.text: Recommend Spiral because technical risks can be evaluated at each iteration.

blocks.title: Worked example · Check and explain
blocks.text: Explain the disadvantage: risk analysis adds project management and cost.
